prompts.glade:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: original standalone painting for a magical parchment notebook.
Primary request: A moonlit woodland glade with softly glowing fireflies and ancient trees. Storybook gouache painting with rich brush texture. Deep forest greens and midnight blues, gentle golden light, a quietly magical atmosphere.
Composition: landscape 3:2, 1536x1024. Ancient tree trunks frame an inviting open glade, moonlight filters through layered canopies, scattered tiny fireflies create warm luminous accents. Full bleed original landscape painting, no border.
Constraints: no text, letters, logos, watermark or UI. No characters or buildings. Deliver one single finished original asset.
prompts.owl:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: original standalone sticker for a magical parchment notebook.
Primary request: One original friendly tiny tawny owl holding a single quill. Storybook gouache illustration, warm brown, amber and cream. Soft expressive face, rounded compact silhouette, detailed painted feather texture. A narrow ivory sticker edge follows the complete owl-and-quill silhouette.
Composition: centered full body, isolated, square 1024x1024 canvas, comfortable transparent margin around the sticker. All parts fully in frame.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha outside the sticker; no scenery, surface, cast shadow or backdrop.
Constraints: one owl only; one quill only; no text, letters, logo, watermark or UI. Deliver a single finished original asset.

assets.description: Friendly tawny owl holding one quill with ivory sticker edge and transparent alpha
Simplified mitosis and cytokinesis. Two copied chromosomes line up, sister chromatids separate, and each daughter cell inherits one of each.
